# Language audit fixtures

All source files in this directory are original fixtures provided under the
repository's Apache-2.0 license. They contain no vendored code or third-party
license obligations. The programs are extraction inputs, not runnable examples.

Each subdirectory uses a tag from the engine language registry. Add source files
in the corresponding directory when extending syntax coverage. See
[the audit guide](../../../../../docs/LANGUAGE-COVERAGE.md) for the golden format,
encoding variants, limitations and regeneration command.
